subject: Obsidian Health — DPA & SCC module options / controller-processor alignment
messages:
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.m@obsidianhealth.com>

Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Obsidian Health — DPA & SCC module options / controller-processor alignment

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the demo this morning. A couple of follow-ups from our security and legal teams:

- Can you confirm Redwood's current SOC 2 status and timeframe for an updated report? Our audit window is Q4 and we need that info for procurement.
- We need a copy of your standard DPA; is there a redlineable Word or PDF that Legal can start with?
- For SCCs, which module does Redwood recommend when the customer is the controller and Redwood is processing pseudonymized/aggregated telemetry? We want to be clear on the "processor" obligations.

If possible, attach the DPA and any SCC guidance. Happy to schedule a quick call if that speeds things up.

Best,
Sofia Martinez
Head of Legal Operations
Obsidian Health

--

Attachment: (none)

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.m@obsidianhealth.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-01T11:04:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Obsidian Health — DPA & SCC module options / controller-processor alignment

Hi Sofia — great to chat. Quick responses inline below and next steps at the end.

- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (Security + Availability) in May 2027. The latest report is available under NDA; if you send a signed NDA we can share the report and our control matrix. Expected cadence: annual attestations with next cycle May 2028.

- DPA: attaching our current DPA (Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf). We typically accept redlines focused on data subject rights and breach notification timelines. For convenience, I'm also uploading a Word copy to the shared drive (link below).

- SCC module: For the scenario you described (customer = controller, Redwood = processor with pseudonymized telemetry), our legal team recommends standard Module Two (Processor to Controller) with the Processor Addendum — it clarifies subprocessors and KV/cache handling. I asked Marcus to add a short note.

Next steps:
1) Marcus to confirm SCC module recommendation and call out any alternative (Marcus: can you confirm by EOD?)
2) Sofia/legal to send NDA if you want the SOC 2 report; otherwise we can provide redacted summary.
3) If you prefer, schedule a 30-min call to walk through DPA + SCC choices; I can bring our security lead.

Thanks — attaching DPA and SCC matrix for quick review.

Best,
Ava Chen
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf
- SCC_module_matrix.xlsx

Related link: https://drive.redwood.com/rdw/RDW-4821/privacy-evidence

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.m@obsidianhealth.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-02T08:30:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Obsidian Health — DPA & SCC module options / controller-processor alignment

Hi Sofia,

Confirming Ava's note: Module 2 (Processor to Controller) is the right starting point for Obsidian's use case. A few clarifications I want to flag:

- Data categories: if you will provide PHI or special category data, we need to scope for HIPAA-specific controls. From our conversation it's telemetry/pseudonymized analytics only — please confirm.
- Subprocessors: we list common cloud infra and inference partners; we can provide a current subprocessors CSV and a commit to 30-day notification for new subprocessors.
- SCC specifics: we'll include the Processor Addendum clauses for restricted processing, deletion/return, and audit rights. For customers requiring additional logging retention above standard, we can add an appendix with engineering estimates and cost impact.

If Obsidian can confirm data types and whether any regulated PHI will be in scope, I will prepare a slim DPA redline with SCC Module 2 references for your counsel to review. Aim to have that to you by EOD 2027-08-03.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Obsidian_Sample_QA.pdf (sample answers to common privacy/security questionnaire items)

From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.m@obsidianhealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-03T16:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Obsidian Health — DPA & SCC module options / controller-processor alignment

Thanks Ava and Marcus — that helps a lot.

Quick answers from our side:
- Data types: only pseudonymized telemetry and event metadata; no patient-identifiable PHI will be shared for this initial integration. We will confirm in writing before any scope changes.
- NDA: attaching our standard mutual NDA (Obsidian_Mutual_NDA.pdf) for SOC 2 access. Once executed we can accept the SOC report.

We'll expect Marcus's redline and will loop our outside counsel for a quick pass. Please include subprocessors CSV when you send the redline.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Let's keep the 30-min call as a backup if any redline items require synchronous discussion.

Best,
Sofia
Head of Legal Operations
Obsidian Health

Attachment: Obsidian_Mutual_NDA.pdf
